claim: Commission CRA guidance (Annex to C(2026) 5252, 27 Jul 2026) paras 129-131 and Example 52: Art. 13(10) 'additional costs' excludes upgrades of underlying software dependencies needed to address end-of-life components but includes mandatory purchases of new hardware, infrastructure replacement or fundamental changes to the operating environment; a smartphone maker may fix only the latest OS major version if users can install it free without new hardware; each substantially modified version needs its own Art. 13(8) period. Example 58: a smartphone integrating an OS does not thereby have the core functionality of an OS. Para 145: modules offered for separate purchase/subscription are standalone products classified on their own core functionality. Para 18/Example 9: manufacturer software needed to operate hardware forms a single product with it even if downloaded separately. Para 57/Example 17: a paid version of a FOSS OS is placed on the market. Para 149: Class I module A via standards needs all requirements of a harmonised standard applied and scope covering all core-functionality risks. [status note: TAG REF-W6-technical]

NVIDIA forum announcement (2023-09-25): JetPack 4 final release targeted Q1 2024, marking its End of Life; Xavier products told to move to JetPack 5; no upgrade path for Jetson Nano stated. [status note: TAG REF-W6-technical]

Connect Tech (2026-05-27): AGX Xavier and Xavier NX top out at JetPack 5.1.5 / L4T 35.6.2 on Ubuntu 20.04 with no JetPack 6 support; Nano, TX2 NX, TX2i capped at JetPack 4.6.x (L4T 32.x) on Ubuntu 18.04; JetPack 6 and later are Orin-only. [source: vendor] [status note: TAG REF-W6-technical]

NVIDIA Jetson Product Lifecycle page lists Orin modules available through January 2032 (AGX Orin Industrial July 2033; Nano Jan 2027; Xavier July 2027) and states no software support duration; EOL notice at least 8 months before last shipment. [status note: TAG REF-W6-technical]

Raspberry Pi engineer/moderator (2025-10-02): 'we do not recommend updating an existing bookworm image, and offer no support for problems encountered when attempting this'; recommended path is a clean trixie image. [source: vendor] [status note: TAG REF-W6-technical]

Draft amendment to CRA standardisation request M/606 (C(2025)618), triggered by CEN/CENELEC/ETSI report of 2025-12-03, moves 26 vertical standards from 30.10.2026 to 31.12.2026; 13 remaining horizontal standards stay 30.10.2027; amendment reported as not yet adopted. [status note: (secondary); TAG REF-W6-technical]

SecureHabits tracker (2026-10-19): EN 304 626 (operating systems) at prEN vote closing mid-November 2026; EN 40000-1-2 adopted; EN 40000-1-4 generic security requirements still drafting; no OJ citation date for any CRA standard; CRA notified bodies still getting up to speed. [status note: (secondary); TAG REF-W6-technical]

Interpretation (needs counsel): a OneMind hardware box is classified by its single core functionality (CRA guidance Example 58, paras 141-145) and is likely not an Annex III 'operating system'; Art. 32(5) FOSS route likely inapplicable to a priced hardware product; box must be screened against Annex III I-1, I-5, I-12, I-16 and Class II container runtime. [status note: interpretation; TAG REF-W6-technical]
